name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance / Women and Child Development

eligibility.other_conditions: Account can be opened by parents/legal guardians for a girl child from birth until age 10. Maximum 2 accounts per family.

benefits: High sovereign-guaranteed interest rate (currently 8.2% p.a.), exempt-exempt-exempt (EEE) tax benefits under Section 80C, for higher education and marriage of girl child.
application_process: Visit any authorized Post Office or designated Commercial Bank branch.
Fill the SSY account opening form.
Submit initial deposit (minimum Rs 250) along with documents.
Collect passbook issued by the bank or post office.
